summary.en: Conan was alone at home; Ran and her father were busy outside. As Conan enjoy leisuring at the Mouri detective agency, Professor Agasa suddenly called him because he want Conan to ask Kogoro to pick him up in the Yamanashi prefecture, due to Agasa's car suddenly stopped working while coming back from a science convention, and had to be towed. Agasa then realized he lost his wallet somewhere, meaning he can't ride a bus even if he wants to. Conan asked why he didn't called "her" to ride a taxi to him, only for "her" (Haibara) to pick up the phone from Agasa and answer him; Haibara is also with Agasa, thus she is stuck with him, too. Location: Somewhere in the Yamanashi prefecture Agasa's car break down while going back to Tokyo. After getting off on the nearest bus stop. He realized he lost his wallet, thus he can't get into a bus as he has no money. Conan then suggest the idea of having Subaru Okiya pick them up, but Haibara refused due to her suspicion of him possibly being a Black Organization member. While also asking if Conan could convinced him to move away. Fortunately, there's a car passing by, and the driver decided to gave them a lift, as they noticed Agasa and Haibara didn't have money to ride a bus. and they were also going to Tokyo as well. Before entering the car, the driver noted that it's a little "tsumoi" (cramped) due to a luggage in the back seat. However, Haibara noticed the driver somehow knows they didn't have money before stopping the car, thus she asked why. The driver answers that it's because she deduced the situation from the strain in Agasa's shirt had the same width as a car's seatbelt. Them not going to the bus despite waiting at a bus stop. And she noticed a yellow car being towed away while she take a stop getting drinks. The car have one driver and one passenger. The driver is a women wearing sunglasses and a pink knit cap. The passenger is a dark-skinned man with a stubble beard, a scar on his left eye, wearing a green jacket. He's sleeping due to not getting much last night. Location: A bus stop in the Yamanashi prefecture A passing car decided to reach out to Agasa and Haibara. Asking if they want to hop in. Coincidentally, the car is also going to Tokyo, specifically the Mouri Detective Agency in Beika Later on, while struck in traffic, the driver asks for Agasa's address. When learning they're living in Beika, the driver also note that they were also going to Beika as well. Specifically to the Mouri Detective Agency. Agasa was going to say that they know the Mouri residences, but was stopped by Haibara. Due to her growing suspicious of the two. Because she spots there are holes created by gunshot, and there were some bloodstrain left on the back seat. Haibara suggested Agasa to pretend sleeping so they can keep and eyes on them in secret. Location: On the back seat of the passing car to Tokyo Weapon: Presumably a gun Suspects: The driver and the passenger of the car Haibara noticed there are three hole likely created by bullets. She also found there are some trace of blood left after the owner of the car clean off the back seat. The male passenger eventually wake up, and asking why there are more "baggage" now. The driver explains the situation, and noted that they're an acquaintances of Kogoro. The male passenger was delighted because it saves them the troble of finding the Detective Agency's location. He then later ask what the driver think of Conan. The driver think he's really smart for a kid, while the passenger thought he's the one pulling all the strings. The driver then asked if what they bring is enough, the passenger said that "Hagoroshi" (half-dead) is enough, and it's not the time for "Minagoroshi" (massacre) just yet. Haibara and Agasa, overheard the entire conversation, were scared. Which make the driver noticed them. She asked if they heard the conversation. Haibara bluff it off as just waking up to due to Agasa's loud snore. The driver then would like to take a rest stop and ask them about their relationship with Kogoro later, if they have the time. The passenger then make comment that if they're too desperate to go home, just get out of the car and "tobu" (run) away. Haibara decided to take on the offer. And when the passenger is getting the map out of the glove compartment to check where's the nearest stop is, Haibara noticed it also have a handgun inside. When they're at a rest stop. Agasa is talking with the two people. Instructed by Haibara to only say he knows Kogoro and Conan from a missing cat case. While Haibara, pretend to go the restroom, take the chance to call Conan and explain the situation. Conan asked why she didn't ran away. Haibara reply it's because of the "Hagoroshi" and "Minagoroshi" comment the passenger made earlier. Haibara interpreted the meaning as they're going to beat them 'half to death' first to get information, then 'massacre' everyone later. Conan decided to go to them, since the rest stop is only 30 minutes away from the detective agency if he's using his Turbo Engine Skateboard to get there. And ask Haibara to hold them for that long, by saying they happened to meet an acquaintance returning from Chiba to Tokyo, and they're going with them instead. (when in truth, they are hiding somewhere until Conan came) By purposefully telling them a lie. Conan want to test if they're smart enough to catch on the lie, and start looking for them afterward. Making them a potential suspect of a Black Organization member. After Agasa and Haibara doing what Conan told them to, the two people catch on to the lie instantly. Thinking it's likely because they heard the "Hagoroshi" comment, and start looking for them. Agasa and Haibara were hiding in a male restroom talking with Conan on a phone to update on the situation. Which they explain the description of the two, the details inside their car, and the unusual words. Soon after, the male passenger start checking the restroom one by one. Being pressed on for what to do next, Conan start thinking about all the info given to him and came to a solution to get out of this predicament.
